relationships.subject: P2X7 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: K+ efflux induced by extracellular ATP goes through a purinergic P2X7-dependent channel, resulting in the assembly and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: NLRP3

key_findings: Schisandrin B reduced SCG P2X7, NLRP3 and IL-1β in diabetic rats and improved blood pressure, heart rate, HRV and sympathetic discharge.
